heard: Staff measured a growing bend, two days later the Quebec Bridge fell. On August 27, steel member 9L bent farther. Some called it critical, the superintendent saw no danger. On August 29, the unfinished bridge collapsed. The commission found the lower members were defectively designed. It did not believe the fall preventable after August 27. 75 workers died, better judgment the commission said might have saved lives, the bend had been measured.
